arguments.query: SELECT p.category, COUNT(*) c, COUNT(DISTINCT r.refund_id) d, MIN(r.refund_ts), MAX(r.refund_ts) FROM refunds r JOIN order_items oi ON oi.item_id=r.item_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id WHERE r.refund_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND r.refund_ts < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY c DESC
SELECT refund_ts, item_id FROM refunds LIMIT 5
SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(item_id IS NULL) FROM refunds WHERE refund_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND refund_ts < '2026-01-01'
